title: White Fang
author: Jack London
short_summary: White Fang, part wolf and part dog, grows up in the harsh Yukon wilderness, first among Native Americans and later under the cruel ownership of a man named Beauty Smith, who forces him to fight other dogs. Rescued by a kinder owner, Weedon Scott, White Fang slowly learns to trust again and becomes a loyal, gentle companion.
extended_summary:
Born in the frozen wild to a wolf father and a part-dog mother, White Fang spends his earliest years learning the harsh law of the wilderness, where only the strongest survive. When he's taken in by a Native American camp, he learns to live alongside humans for the first time, though never quite trusting them. His life takes a darker turn when he's sold to Beauty Smith, a cruel man who deliberately makes him vicious and forces him into brutal dogfights for money.

Just when White Fang has been beaten into something closer to a wild animal than ever, he's bought and rescued by Weedon Scott, who is the first person to ever show him patient kindness. Slowly, carefully, White Fang lets his guard down and learns that not every hand is raised against him. He follows Scott all the way to a gentle life on a California ranch, where the once-feral wolf-dog ultimately proves his loyalty by saving the family from an escaped, dangerous convict.
